title: Hyoma
overview: Kunato Hyoma, who harbors a hatred for tsukumogami, is forced to live with a house full of them and their enigmatic mistress, Nagatsuki Botan.

title: Shoreline
overview: A bad first impression threatens to get Hyoma kicked out of his new home after only three days if he can't win over his tsukumogami hosts.

title: Overflow
overview: Hyoma has one more tsukumogami's support to earn before he'll be allowed to stay in the Nagatsuki household... but Yu seems completely unyielding.

title: Arrangement
overview: Having earned his right to remain in the Nagatsuki residence for a year, Hyoma learns about the ulterior motive behind his stay.

title: Suspicions
overview: An overly cautious Hyoma is forced to remove protective talismans he set up around the town, and learns more about Nagatsuki Botan in the process.

title: Botan
overview: After his cryptic encounter with Aogi, Hyoma is determined to learn more about Botan. Haori is happy to explain, if only he'll be willing to listen...

title: Quickening
overview: Hyoma visits the Saenome of Kyoto, the Kadomori Clan, to get permission to act on their territory. But the Kadomoris have their own intentions...

title: Circumstances
overview: A curveball thrown at Hyoma by Kadomori Taiju forces him to confront some of the ways he's changed.

title: Fire
overview: Hyoma teams up with Yu and Tsubaki to fight a gang of tsukumogami who've begun targeting Kadomoris for torture.

title: Radiance
overview: Tsubaki makes Hyoma an offer he might not be able to refuse, and the Nagatsuki tsukumogami hold a party.

title: Ambush
overview: Hyoma looks into acquiring some better defenses, but acquiring Saenome armor requires him to pass a test.

title: Efflorescence
overview: The battle with Kai reveals secrets that the Nagatsukis would rather leave unknown.
